### Collaboration and Communication Services

**BIOMES (Bern Intestinal Organisms and Microbial Ecosystems Society)** supports its members and contributors in achieving the association’s mission. Below, you will find information on our official communication and collaboration platforms.

### Microsoft Accounts for Collaboration and Communication

For external communications, association projects, and collaborations, BIOMES members may use Microsoft accounts.

-   **BIOMES Microsoft email**: Your official BIOMES email for Microsoft accounts and external communication follows this format: firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org
-   **Accessing Microsoft Services**:\
    1.  Visit [Microsoft 365 Login](https://portal.office.com)
    2.  Sign in using your BIOMES Microsoft email and password
    3.  Access Outlook, OneDrive, and Teams

### Google Workspace for Collaboration

Members have the option to use **Google Workspace** tools such as Google Drive, Docs, and Meet.

-   **BIOMES Google email**: Your official BIOMES email for Google Workspace login follows this format: firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org. Please note that Gmail is not activated as BIOMES uses Microsoft Outlook as email service; emails to firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org will be received in your Microsoft Outlook mailbox.
-   **Accessing Google Workspace**:\
    1.  Visit [Google Account Login](https://accounts.google.com)
    2.  Sign in with your assigned BIOMES Google email and password
    3.  Use Google Drive, and other tools for internal collaboration

### GitHub Organizational Resources

BIOMES maintains an official GitHub organization account for research-related software development and repository management.

-   **GitHub Organization**: [github.com/biomes-research](https://github.com/biomes-research)
-   **Request Access**: If you need access to repositories, contact an administrator or request membership via GitHub.\
-   **Collaboration**: Use GitHub Issues and Discussions to communicate within projects.

### Need Assistance?

For any issues related to Microsoft accounts, Google Workspace, or GitHub access, please reach out to the BIOMES IT team ([it\@biomes-research.org](mailto:it@biomes-research.org)).
